# Credit limit (`credit-limit` v1)

PFE limit by tenor bucket for a counterparty, with utilisation.

**Group:** Exposure and capital · **Mnemonic:** `LIM` · **Identifiers:** `LIM-…` in `limitId`

Open one with `LIM <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: credit-limit
version: 1
description: "PFE limit by tenor bucket for a counterparty, with utilisation."
match: { kind: credit-limit, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Exposure and capital · Credit limit, id: $.limitId }
strip:
  - { label: Counterparty, bind: $.counterpartyName }
  - { label: Measure, bind: $.measure }
  - { label: Limit, bind: $.limit, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Used, bind: $.used, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Utilisation, bind: $.utilisation, fmt: pct0, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Status, bind: $.status, tone: status }
panels:
  - id: buckets
    kind: table
    title: By tenor bucket
    key: F2
    rows: $.buckets
    columns:
      - { label: Bucket, bind: "@.bucket" }
      - { label: Limit, bind: "@.limit", fmt: compact }
      - { label: Used, bind: "@.used", fmt: compact }
      - { label: Utilisation, bind: "@.utilisation", fmt: pct0 }
  - id: util
    kind: hbar
    title: Utilisation
    area: right
    rows: $.buckets
    label: bucket
    value: utilisation
    fmt: pct0
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.counterparty, 'counterparty')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
